name: 64503 · Saint Joseph, MO
findings: ZIP 64503 (Saint Joseph) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64503 (Saint Joseph) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
